risks_named_before_the_run: TRANSFER. Both games are known to carry other machinery — ...bo3-2661861148 is the game whose Light Screen tick is named in the residual-stop block's own header — so either may re-enter the count on a later divergence. A game that leaves and re-enters on a different cause is a TRANSFER and is reported as one, not as a failure to close.

OVER-FIRE. The drain is gated on `_ranExpiryHandler`, set by the perish step alone, so it cannot reach a group with no perish counter in it. A rise in narration would mean the group-major walk emits a perishN line at a point the authority does not, which the probe's CTRL-NONE arm would not have seen.

BOARD. drainFaints writes no state; the only thing it moves is faintQueueOwed(), which the group-top stop reads — and the new call is placed BELOW the existing wipe block, which has already broken out of the turn on the one path where the two interact. If board-material moves at all, this run's narration figures are WITHHELD and the fix is corrected.
lower_bound_note: The ordering count is a LOWER BOUND on what is left: a game records only its FIRST divergence, so closing one cause can reveal another in the same game.
